name: MoLang Float
description: Allows MoLang usage to calculate an float

fields.description: MoLang query

name: Active Mode
description: Returns the key of the active mode of a mode switch ability.

fields.description: The mode switch ability to read the active mode from.
MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Flight Speed
description: A flight speed that follows an argon:flight_speed_adjuster dial: "base" plus the dial's value divided by its division_amount. Use it for a flight type's "speed" and "sprint_speed". Just "base" while the ability is off.

fields.description: The flight speed adjuster ability whose dial to follow.
The speed with the dial at zero; the dial's bonus is added to this.

name: Float Data Attachment
description: Returns the value of a data attachment, which must be a float.

fields.description: The ID of the data attachment.
Used if the data attachment type doesn't exist, for example because it comes from a mod that isn't installed. Entities without a value for the attachment use its default value instead.
MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Max Number
description: Returns the highest number found within the given values

fields.description: List of values
The required number type the result should be formatted as

name: Attribute
description: Returns the attribute value of the entity.

fields.description: The id of the attribute to return.
MoLang function to modify the value.

fields.description: The value to convert.

description: Allows MoLang usage to assemble a string

fields.description: MoLang query

name: Smoothed
description: A number that slides toward another value at a steady speed instead of jumping, so stepped values like a beam's range change smoothly. Each entity has its own figure, which restarts if unread for half a second.

fields.description: The value to follow.
How far it moves towards a higher value each second, in the wrapped value's own unit.
How far it moves towards a lower value each second; the same as "speed" if left out.

name: Energy Bar
description: Returns of the current value of a specific energy bar.

fields.description: The energy bar to look for. Defined in this syntax: <power_namespace>:<power_name>#<energy_bar_key>
MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Convert to Float
description: Converts the result of another value to a float.

fields.description: The value to convert.
MoLang function to modify the value.

description: Allows MoLang usage to calculate an integer

name: Slim Player Model
description: Checks if the entity is a player and has the slim-armed (Alex) player model.

fields.description: The string to return if the result is true. If omitted, the value returns true.
The string to return if the result is false. If omitted, the value returns false.

name: Moon Phase
description: Returns the current moon phase, an integer from 0 to 7.

fields.description: MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Event Data
description: Reads a number or string from the data of the custom event that started the current automation. Booleans are stored as 1 or 0. Returns 0 if there is no event or nothing exists at the path.

fields.description: Path to the entry in the event data. Use dots to go into nested objects, e.g. "reward.tier".

name: Score
description: Returns the score of the entity for the given objective. Only works on the server.

fields.description: The name of the scoreboard objective.
MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Gliding Tick Count
description: Returns the amount of ticks since the entity is gliding (using elytra or ability).

fields.description: MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Entity Tick Count
description: Returns the tick count of the entity.

fields.description: MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Crouching
description: Checks if the entity is crouching.

fields.description: The string to return if the result is true. If omitted, the value returns true.
The string to return if the result is false. If omitted, the value returns false.

name: Ability Tick Count
description: Returns the ticks the ability in the context has been enabled for.

fields.description: The ability to get the ticks from. Defined in this syntax: <power_namespace>:<power_name>#<ability_key>
MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Ability Key
description: Returns the key of the ability in the context.

fields.description: MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Beam Charge
description: Scales a value by how charged the shot of a charged argon:energy_beam was. Use it in that beam's damage, knockback or lift. Multiplies "value" by "min" at no charge and "max" at full charge.

fields.description: The value to scale.
The multiplier at the lowest charge.
The multiplier at full charge.

name: Conditional Value
description: Returns a value based on whether a condition is met.

fields.description: The condition(s) to test.
The value to return if the condition is met.
The value to return if the condition is not met.

name: Wide Player Model
description: Checks if the entity is a player and has the wide-armed (Steve) player model.

fields.description: The string to return if the result is true. If omitted, the value returns true.
The string to return if the result is false. If omitted, the value returns false.

name: Min Number
description: Returns the lowest number found within the given values

fields.description: List of values
The required number type the result should be formatted as

name: Power Age
description: The age, in days, counted by an argon:time_growth ability: the time the ability has been enabled for the player, as a decimal. 0 if the ability is missing.

fields.description: The argon:time_growth ability whose age to read.

name: Size
description: Returns the entity's current size. If a size change type is specified, returns that type's specific modifier value instead of the overall size.

fields.description: The size change type whose modifier to return. If omitted, the overall current size is returned.
MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Slot
description: Returns the slot of the current context.

fields.description: MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Text Component Data Attachment
description: Returns the value of a data attachment as a text component.

fields.description: The ID of the data attachment.
Used if the data attachment type doesn't exist, for example because it comes from a mod that isn't installed. Entities without a value for the attachment use its default value instead.
MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Static Value
description: Utilises a simple, static value

fields.description: A simple, static value.

name: Item Custom Value
description: A number a Tech Table module wrote onto the item in the given slot with its "argon:custom_value" effect, under the name given there. Uses the fallback if the item has no such value.

fields.description: The slot whose item to read, e.g. an armor slot or a curios slot.
The name the value was given in the module's effect.
What to use when the item does not have the value.

name: Ability Animation Timer Value
description: Returns the value of the animation timer for the specified ability. Defaults to 0 if no ability or animation timer was found.

fields.description: The ability to get the animation timer for. Defined in this syntax: <power_namespace>:<power_name>#<ability_key>
MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Entity Health
description: Returns the health of the entity.

fields.description: MoLang function to modify the value.

name: Item Open
description: Checks if an item was opened.

fields.description: Slot to check for. If none specified, it will use the slot from the current context (if given).
The string to return if the result is true. If omitted, the value returns true.
The string to return if the result is false. If omitted, the value returns false.

name: Item Open Timer
description: Returns of the timer for the opening process of an item.

fields.description: Slot to check for. If none specified, it will use the slot from the current context (if given).
